workflows.intent: Authenticate, search for Mug, and verify the target product is visible.
Authenticate, search for Mug, open the target product, and verify its detail page.
Authenticate, search for Mug, open the target product, return to results, reopen it, and verify the detail page.
workflows.oracle: database-product-search plus visible repeated navigation milestones

protocol_boundary: Every execution uses a fresh browser context and its own append-only run record and replay trace.
The application/database is not mutated by these read-only workflows; a batch-level database snapshot is checked before and after collection.
Authentication is a matched scripted preamble; the provider sees only the authenticated task state.
Pure visual receives screenshots only; hybrid receives screenshots plus visible pageStructure and may use semantic target ids.
The independent database oracle is separate from the agent verdict and visible milestone checks.
This is an exploratory diagnostic batch, not a three-arm matched estimate or superiority claim.
The complexity distribution and provider/model/profile are fixed before execution and must not be changed after inspecting outcomes.
